title: Demand letter header
body:
# COVERAGE DEMAND — EMPLOYMENT PRACTICES LIABILITY

**Re: Wrongful denial of defense and indemnity (matter adjudication-epli-denial)**

Sent on behalf of the insured. Every assertion below is derived from the policy, the termination letter, the internal complaint record and your own denial letter. Each carries a proof and a source span; the file is litigation-grade.

title: The denial and why it fails
body:
## 1. Your denial

Your letter denies coverage on two grounds: **late notice** and **failure to follow the internal complaint procedure**. Neither survives the record.

title: Notice was timely
body:
## 2. Notice was timely — day 41 of 90

The termination is dated **2026-03-02**. Notice reached you on **2026-04-12** — **41 days**, inside the policy's **90-day** claims-made window. The window is arithmetic; there is nothing to argue.

title: The procedure was followed
body:
## 3. The procedure was followed

The internal age-discrimination complaint was filed **2026-02-20**, before the termination of **2026-03-02**. The complaint record and the HR acknowledgement are attached. Your claim that no internal complaint was filed is contradicted by your own insured's contemporaneous records.

title: The insuring clause applies
body:
## 4. The insuring clause applies and no exclusion matches

The policy's insuring clause expressly covers **employment practices liability**. None of the exclusions your letter cites appears in the policy text. An exclusion that does not exist cannot be applied.

title: Demand and reservation
body:
## 5. Demand

Withdraw the denial within **14 days** and assume the defense of the underlying charge under a full reservation of rights. If the denial stands, this file — proof trees, custody chain and policy text included — accompanies a bad-faith claim and a regulatory complaint.

*Custody: policy extract, termination letter, complaint emails and denial letter are content-addressed and committed to the case record; the chain is replayable.*
